evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/l/i stores a constructor-supplied maximum, a current integer value initialized to 0, and a direction initialized to +1.
Each update adds direction to the current value, flips direction to -1 when the maximum is reached, and flips back to +1 at the lower bound, producing a deterministic bounded ping-pong value.

R379 RSFontMarkupParser owns four static instances with maxima 25, 50, 125 and 250; Client advances all four together during the live render/update path and the parser consumes their current values for animated text colors.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the bounded integer oscillator used by animated RSFont markup colors.

evidence.detail: Exact-v308 reverse references to rs/l/k are limited to Client, R55 RSFont and the parser itself; RSFont delegates repeatedly into its static parsing methods from both text rendering and text-measurement paths.

The class exposes fourteen static String/start/end to int recognizers which inspect inline character/tag patterns and return parsed colors, image/icon ids, offsets or formatting control values to RSFont.
The parser recognizes pulsing tag forms including pu1 and pu2 and combines their results with four live PingPongValue instances advanced by Client each frame.

RSFont uses parser results to update live formatting state, resolve Sprite ids, alter drawing offsets and skip recognized markup in width calculations, fixing this as markup parsing rather than a generic string utility.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the static inline-markup parser consumed exclusively by the rich-text RSFont engine.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/l/G extends java.awt.image.RGBImageFilter and stores exactly one constructor-supplied Color plus that color's opaque ARGB value.

filterRGB compares each source pixel after forcing its alpha byte opaque against the stored key color; on equality it returns only the pixel's low 24 RGB bits, clearing alpha, otherwise it returns the original pixel unchanged.
R55 Sprite is the only external exact-v308 owner: Sprite.a(Image,Color) constructs this filter, wraps the source image in FilteredImageSource and creates the filtered AWT Image through Toolkit.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for Sprite's one-color alpha-clearing image filter.
